name: Monotone Sector Visibility / Anchored Dark Resolution Band
parents: Chirality Landscape Version 1 local QFT/GR readouts
hypothesis: For each sector s in {Q,G}, rho_s,Ri = q^s_ji o rho_s,Rj whenever Ri<=Rj.
theorem_1: Pers_s is upward closed in every nested monotone Resolution filtration.
thresholds: R_s^*=min Pers_s when the minimum exists.
theorem_2: If R_G^*<R_Q^*, DarkRes={R | R_G^*<=R<R_Q^*}; if R_G^*>=R_Q^*, the sector-relative dark band is empty on the modeled chain.
anchor_specialization: Use p_H in S3, Sigma_H=pi^-1(p_H)~=S2 and h_H=Hol_H(gamma_H) for the black-hole-anchored galactic branch.
guardrails: sector-specific nested coarsening is an explicit hypothesis
order thresholds are not scalar profiles
Resolution is not dark matter by identity
readout identity is not formal destruction or additive zero
